title: LLMLingua: Compressing Prompts for Accelerated Inference of Large Language Models
cost_reduction_reported: up to 20x prompt compression with little performance loss on GSM8K/BBH/ShareGPT/Arxiv-March23
summary: Coarse-to-fine prompt compression that uses a small language model to drop low-information tokens. A budget controller allocates compression across prompt parts (instructions, demonstrations, question), and an iterative token-level algorithm models dependencies between kept tokens; the small model is instruction-tuned to align with the target LLM.
key_idea: Use a small LM's perplexity to prune prompt tokens before sending to an expensive black-box LLM.
relevance_rationale: Core prompt-compression technique that directly cuts input-token cost for API-served agents.

title: LongLLMLingua: Accelerating and Enhancing LLMs in Long Context Scenarios via Prompt Compression
cost_reduction_reported: up to 17.1% accuracy gain over the original prompt with ~4x fewer tokens on NaturalQuestions (GPT-3.5-Turbo); cost savings of $28.5 and $27.4 per 1,000 samples on LongBench and ZeroScrolls
summary: Extends LLMLingua to long-context settings by making compression question-aware, reordering documents to counter position bias, and allocating dynamic compression ratios across documents. It shows compression can both cut cost and improve accuracy in long-context RAG.
key_idea: Question-aware compression plus reordering fixes both cost and lost-in-the-middle effects.
relevance_rationale: Long-context compression directly applicable to RAG-heavy and tool-output-heavy agent steps.

summary: Recasts prompt compression as token classification: GPT-4 is used to produce extractive compressed versions of MeetingBank transcripts, and a small bidirectional encoder is trained to predict which tokens to keep. The result is task-agnostic, faithful (extractive) and much faster than perplexity-based compressors.
key_idea: Distil a frontier model's compression judgments into a small token classifier.
relevance_rationale: Cheap, task-agnostic compressor usable in front of any frontier-model agent call; also an example of distilling frontier behavior.

key_idea: Embedding-similarity cache in front of an LLM API to skip repeated or paraphrased calls.

summary: User-side semantic cache in which each device keeps a local cache and a query-similarity model trained with federated learning, so user queries never leave the device. key_idea: Federated, context-aware semantic caching to cut repeated LLM calls while reducing false hits.
